title: Reimagining Support: Exploring Autistic Individuals’ Visions for AI in Coping with Negative Self-Talk

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative evaluation by mental health practitioners of LLM (ChatGPT and Claude) responses to hypothetical negative self-talk prompts generated by autistic users to identify non-inclusive, neurotypical-centric language (e.g., vague expressions, jargon, and lack of actionable guidance). This is complemented by a survey of 200 autistic adults assessing their concerns about ableist models misinterpreting their unique thought processes and communication styles.
